decisions.decision: Library closed until Friday March 27th; staff continue reporting for regular hours.
decisions.quote: the library will be closed until friday march 27th. staff will still be reporting for regular hours.

decisions.quote: muir said that they will quarantine returned books for a week unless we receive more specific info about the risks from surface contact.
